html_injection_revocation.policy: Never inject raw <style>, <script>, or arbitrary HTML code widgets. All elements must use native builder widgets.

nested_component_repeater_protocol.policy: When modifying repeating components, audit parent container model first and duplicate in-place via $e.run('document/repeater/duplicate') rather than dropping standalone widgets.

color_contrast_and_accessibility.policy: Text over dark overlays must be styled in pure white (#FFFFFF) with Gold accents (#EAB308) and semi-transparent shielding (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)).

sidebar_exclusion_zone.policy: Reject coordinate actions where x < 300px to prevent accidental sidebar drag-start events.

dpi_normalization_gate.policy: Query window.devicePixelRatio before every coordinate action and normalize coordinates when dpr > 1.0.

domain_boundary_lock.policy: Validate page.url() matches target domain before and after every Playwright CDP action.

save_verification_protocol.policy: End modification batches with explicit $e.run('document/save/auto') and verify HTTP response status.

panel_selection_verification.policy: Query active element ID prior to panel input to confirm alignment with target widget ID.

core_rules: ALWAYS perform a mandatory DOM/parent-container pre-audit before inserting elements.
NEVER drag and drop standalone widgets into structured parent repeater containers.
ALWAYS duplicate existing child elements when adding items to accordions, tabs, FAQs, or icon lists.
dos: Pre-Audit Requirement: Force a DOM lookup step before taking layout actions (prevents No DOM Pre-Audit Protocol).

Duplication Protocol: Mandate using Elementor's native duplicate command (.elementor-repeater-tool-duplicate) to guarantee styling inheritance for typography, background tokens, hover states, and keyboard tab order.
Accessibility Shielding: Require pure white text (#FFFFFF) with semi-transparent overlays (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)) for text layered over dark containers.
Save Verification: After every modification batch, trigger $e.run('document/save/auto') and verify response.
Domain Boundary Lock: Assert page.url() matches target domain before and after every action.
DPI Normalization: Query devicePixelRatio and divide coordinates when dpr !== 1.0.
Panel Selection Verification: Verify selected element ID matches intended target before panel modifications.
donts: NEVER fall back to standalone widget creation when hasRepeaterAdd returns false.
NEVER use createElement API to instantiate new widgets when existing structures can be duplicated.
NEVER inject raw HTML via style, script, or HTML Code widgets.
NEVER click within the sidebar exclusion zone (x < 300px) during canvas operations.
NEVER execute consecutive click actions without stabilization screenshot.
NEVER rely on default paragraph text colors (#334155) over dark overlays.
enforcement_rules.detection_and_purge: If a background fill mismatch (#FFFFFF vs #F0F4F9) or broken tab order is detected during post-action visual audit, immediately locate and delete the rogue standalone widget using Elementor Navigator panel, then execute the In-Place Repeater Duplication Protocol.
